name: Dry Hills
summary: Witchwing harpies menace the Dry Hills, where greener slopes rise above the Barrens.

sections.title: A Green Haven for Harpies
sections.body: The Dry Hills grow greener than the dry plains below, on the Barrens' northwestern edge beneath the Stonetalon Mountains. Travelers find little safety among the bluffs. Serena Bloodfeather leads the Witchwing harpies from their roosts along the crags. Their raiding parties swoop down on supply caravans along the northern Gold Road. Abandoned orcish fortifications and derelict siege engines lie rotting in the brush.

sections.title: Threat to the Crossroads
sections.body: Witchwing harpies strike out from the hills to bleed trade routes and harass nearby settlements, so the Horde keeps a standing bounty on their feathers. In the rocky ravines, their nests and roosts are heavily defended. Hecklefang hyenas prowl there, and fierce Sunscale raptors hunt across the highlands.

faq.q: Why is it called the Dry Hills if it's so green?
faq.answer: Despite their name, the Dry Hills are noticeably greener than the surrounding Barrens. No record explains the name or this local contrast.

faq.q: Who lives in the Dry Hills?
faq.answer: The Witchwing tribe of harpies controls almost all of the hills, under Serena Bloodfeather's rule. Hecklefang hyenas and Sunscale raptors also roam the rocky slopes.

faq.q: Why is the Horde interested in this area?
faq.answer: Witchwing raiders strike out from the hills to plunder supply caravans along the northern Gold Road. Horde commanders issue bounties to cull their numbers and eliminate their leaders.

faq.q: What are the ruined towers and catapults in the middle of the hills?
faq.answer: The towers and catapults are remains of an abandoned orcish outpost. The surviving structures do not establish its original mission or why it was deserted.

angles.text: Witchwing harpies nesting in the Dry Hills threaten the northern trade routes linking the Crossroads to Stonetalon and Ashenvale. Horde champions must regularly cull them.
The rugged uplands offer rich hunting grounds, with swift Hecklefang hyenas, predatory Sunscale scytheclaws, and fierce harpies.
